## 1. Tool Definitions (function schemas)
I have access to these tools, each with a JSON schema (abbreviated here since you already see my tool list above):
- **read** — read files/dirs/archives/SQLite/images/URLs via `path`, with selector syntax (`:50-200`, `:raw`, etc.)
- **bash** — persistent shell, restricted from search/find/servers (must use grep/glob/hub instead)
- **edit** — line-anchored patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS ops keyed to a snapshot `#TAG`)
- **ask** — clarifying questions with structured options
- **eval** — persistent Python/JS kernel (IPython-style, Bun for JS)
- **glob** — fast path pattern matching
- **grep** — regex search (Rust regex + PCRE2)
- **task** — spawn background subagents (scout, reviewer, librarian, task, sonic, designer)
- **hub** — peer messaging + supervised long-running processes (start/stop/logs/send/wait)
- **todo** — phased task tracker (init/start/done/drop/block/unblock/append/view)
- **web_search** — web search with Google-style directives
- **write** — create/overwrite files (incl. archive members, SQLite rows)
